items.title: الشمس بيراميدز للفنادق والمنشأت السياحية (SPHT.CA) تعلن نتائج أعمالها عن الفترة: من 01/01/2026 إلى 30/06/2026
items.title_en: Pyramids Hotels (SPHT.CA) announces its financial results for the period: from 01/01/2026 to 30/06/2026
items.meaning: The company published what it earned or lost over a period. The figures are the company's own, filed with the exchange.
